info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Consumer Advisory Services API
info.description: The Consumer Advisory Services API provides essential financial guidance and information tailored to consumers seeking to enhance their banking experience. This endpoint enables users to access specialized advisory resources based on specific parameters, offering insights into banking products and services. Typical consumers include individuals looking for personalized financial advice or assistance in managing their accounts. By leveraging this API, organizations can help their clients make informed decisions regarding their financial services.

get.summary: Retrieve Consumer Advisory Service by ID
get.description: Fetch detailed information about a specific Consumer Advisory Service using its unique identifier. This endpoint allows clients to access service details for further consultation and decision-making.

requestBody.description: Request body for obtaining consumer advisory services related to the specific resource identified by RES-100045. This request allows clients to fetch relevant information and guidance pertaining to consumer needs.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the requested consumer advisory service data.
